saw.short: KFC UK joins GTA VI launch day with a pink Cadillac
saw.headline: *KFC UK* joins GTA VI launch day with a pink Cadillac
saw.what: KFC UK and Ireland says it will deliver GTA-inspired “Cluck n’ Bell” meals from a hot pink Cadillac to a limited number of London competition winners on Thursday 19 Nov, per Dexerto. It is inspired by GTA’s Cluckin’ Bell but isn’t an official Rockstar collaboration. KFC Australia is also staging a fake funeral for a GTA day off, which is Australia only.
saw.why: Brands are fighting for a slice of launch day. KFC’s version is local and visual.

saw.short: McDonald's UK Christmas menu brings back Home Alone
saw.headline: *McDonald’s UK* Christmas menu brings back Home Alone
saw.what: McDonald’s UK and Ireland’s Christmas menu launched on 17 Nov, per Metro, with a Home Alone Meal that includes a pair of socks in a mystery box, from £9.49. Macaulay Culkin is back as Kevin in the ad. Famous Campaigns says the Home Alone Meal reaches US restaurants on 1 December, which isn’t the UK date.
saw.why: A nostalgic film link inside a food launch. A strong template for film-led brand work.

saw.short: Amazon's Prime holiday ad stars Arnold Schwarzenegger as Santa
saw.headline: *Amazon’s Prime holiday ad* stars Arnold Schwarzenegger as Santa
saw.what: Amazon’s new Prime holiday ad has Arnold Schwarzenegger ordering a Santa suit and going undercover in New York, per Amazon’s own page. It promotes the Prime Video film The Man with the Bag, streaming globally from 2 December, and deals run 19–30 Nov. Amazon’s page is US-based, so we haven’t confirmed the UK run.
saw.why: A celebrity ad that doubles as a film trailer. The UK run is not confirmed.

saw.short: BBC puts most Christmas specials on iPlayer from 27 Nov
saw.headline: The *BBC* puts most Christmas specials on iPlayer from 27 Nov
saw.what: Most of the BBC’s 2026 Christmas specials, including Death in Paradise and Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing, arrive on iPlayer from Friday 27 Nov, per a BBC statement quoted by Metro. Metro says viewers are divided on X, with some calling it too early. It isn’t the whole schedule.
saw.why: Christmas TV is arriving four weeks early. People have strong opinions about it.

saw.short: Arsenal's Max Dowman, 16, becomes England U21's youngest scorer
saw.headline: Arsenal’s *Max Dowman*, 16, becomes England U21’s youngest scorer
saw.what: Arsenal’s Max Dowman, 16, scored a late winner in England Under-21s’ 3-2 win over France in Bristol on Monday, becoming their youngest ever scorer, per Metro and ESPN. Metro puts his age at 16 years 320 days. He had become their youngest ever player on Friday, as a substitute against Portugal. England’s match against France was a friendly.
saw.why: A teenage record with a clip that travels. Football fans love a prodigy.

saw.short: The Hunger Games prequel opens Friday after its New York premiere
saw.headline: *The Hunger Games* prequel opens Friday after its New York premiere
saw.what: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opens in UK cinemas on Friday 20 Nov. The original cast, including Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Woody Harrelson and Elizabeth Banks, attended its New York premiere on Monday, per indy100. Radio Times calls it a 158-minute spectacle.
saw.why: A big film week for the cinema calendar. Useful for Disney UK’s own countdown.

platform.short: Instagram brings content protection to creators
platform.headline: Instagram brings *content protection* to creators
platform.what: Instagram says eligible creators who enrol will get alerts when others repost their original videos, with matches found across Instagram and Facebook. It was previously Facebook-only, per Instagram’s own post. Eligibility and markets aren’t stated.
platform.why: A tool against reposted work. Check if client creators qualify.
platform.source: Instagram, 17 Nov; Social Media Today, 17 Nov

platform.short: YouTube adds estimated co-views to TV view counts
platform.headline: YouTube adds *estimated co-views* to TV view counts
platform.what: YouTube says public view counts now include estimated co-views for plays on TV, using a model, and that it never uses cameras, microphones or sensors. Phone, tablet and computer plays still count once. It adds a private “co-view rate” metric in Studio and says it doesn’t affect revenue or Partner Programme eligibility.
platform.why: TV views may count for more than one person. Reach numbers will shift.

platform.short: Meta tests a standalone messaging app called Direct
platform.headline: Meta tests a standalone messaging app called *Direct*
platform.what: Meta says it is testing Direct, a standalone messaging app from Instagram, in Türkiye and Thailand on Android and iOS. Users must be 13 or over, and existing Instagram chats sync across both apps. Meta’s post doesn’t call it a teen app. It is a test, not a launch.
platform.why: Meta is testing a split between Instagram and its messaging. Nothing live in the UK.
platform.source: Meta, 17 Nov; Social Media Today, 17 Nov
